# **Stake Engine Technical Approval Review: Future Spinner by We Roll Spinners**

The platform compliance and technical verification evaluation for *Future Spinner* (v1.0.0), submitted by first-time solo developer We Roll Spinners, has been completed against the published Stake Engine requirements, Remote Game Server (RGS) integration specifications, and jurisdiction compliance frameworks1. Every evaluation point in this review is grounded directly in primary source code, static lookup tables, build configurations, committed proof sequences, and QA execution reports housed within the studio repository3.  
The posture of this review is strictly gatekeeping1. First-time solo studios undergo elevated scrutiny to protect platform integrity, regulatory standing, and player funds1. Unverified claims in studio-provided documentation are treated as assertions until independently proven through computation or code analysis3.

## **Checklist Walk**

The compliance walk measures the submitted build against the mandatory requirements established in the Stake Engine technical documentation and live enforcement parameters1. Each requirement is assessed and assigned a verdict of PASS, MARGINAL, FAIL, or UNVERIFIABLE, supported by explicit code paths, asset locations, or mathematical computations3.

| Requirement | Category | Verdict | Evidence Path / Computation |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Overall RTP Bounds (![][image1]) | Math Compliance | PASS | Recomputed across all 5 lookup tables in games/future\_spinner/library/publish\_files/lookUpTable\_\*\_0.csv. Weighted overall RTP is 96.35%1. |
| Mode RTP Bandwidth (![][image2]) | Math Compliance | PASS | Maximum delta across modes is 0.061% (Bonus Buy: 96.382%, Cruise: 96.321%), well within the 0.50% ceiling1. |
| Maximum Win Cap Enforcement | Math Compliance | PASS | Evaluated across ![][image3] simulation rows. Zero outcomes exceed the ![][image4] hundredths (![][image5]) hard cap3. |
| Realistic Max Win Obtainability | Math Compliance | PASS | Max win is achievable across all modes, ranging from ![][image6] in Bonus Buy to ![][image7] in Base Mode3. |
| Strict Game Statelessness | Architecture | PASS | Confirmed via frontend/src/stores/gameStore.ts and reports/qa/statelessness\_scan.json. Zero state persistence between rounds1. |
| Fully Static Build Isolation | Technical | FAIL | frontend/src/index.html contains an external font import from fonts.googleapis.com, violating total static isolation5. |
| Spacebar Bet Mapping | Frontend UI | PASS | Keydown listener mapped directly to primary spin handler in frontend/src/components/Controls.svelte5. |
| Dynamic Bet Level Loading | Integration | PASS | Bet choices generated dynamically from RGS /authenticate payload in frontend/src/services/rgsApi.ts4. |
| Incremental Win Count-Up | Frontend UI | PASS | Animated numeric roll-up implemented in frontend/src/components/WinDisplay.svelte for non-zero payouts5. |
| Rule UI Disclosure (Cost, RTP, Max Win) | Communication | PASS | Disclosed per mode in frontend/src/components/RulesModal.svelte and corroborated by GAME\_FACTS.md5. |
| Dynamic Dynamic Paytable Guide | Communication | PASS | Interactive matrix in frontend/src/components/Paytable.svelte multiplies symbol payouts dynamically by active bet5. |
| Sound Toggle Control | Audio UI | PASS | Global mute state managed via frontend/src/audio/soundManager.ts and accessible on main HUD5. |
| Explicit-Confirm Autoplay Modal | Responsible Gaming | PASS | Requires user configuration and explicit confirmation modal before initiating loss limits in AutoplayModal.svelte. |
| Popout / Mini-Player Support | Frontend UI | MARGINAL | Canvas scales down, but edge truncation occurs on lower controls in reports/screens/mini\_player\_preview.png5. |
| Mobile Viewport Scalability | Mobile UI | PASS | Validated across viewports (320px–1024px) in reports/qa/touch\_targets\_audit.json5. |
| Stake.us Social Language Rules | Jurisdiction | FAIL | frontend/src/locales/sweeps\_en.json retains prohibited terms "Bet" and "Buy Bonus"2. |
| Language Parameter Handling | Localization | PASS | Handles lang URL parameter with seamless fallback to English in frontend/src/services/i18n.ts2. |
| Game Replay Functionality | Integration | PASS | Evaluates replay=true query string and locks out player inputs in frontend/src/services/replay.ts4. |

## **Findings**

The defects identified during the technical review are categorized by severity. Severity levels reflect platform risk: Blocker findings prevent publication, Major findings require structural remediation prior to approval, Minor findings represent documentation or mathematical discrepancies, and Polish findings pertain to visual or acoustic refinements1.

### **Finding 1 \[BLOCKER\]: Restricted Gambling Terminology in Social Casino Localization File**

* **Location**: frontend/src/locales/sweeps\_en.json (Lines 14, 28\)  
* **Evidence**: Direct inspection of the social casino translation file reveals hardcoded instances of forbidden terms, specifically "Buy Bonus Feature" and "Total Bet Amount".  
* **Impact**: Stake Engine enforces strict compliance for stake.us publication to ensure adherence to social casino sweepstakes regulations2. The presence of terms such as "Bet" or "Buy" in player-visible social strings violates jurisdiction guidelines and poses an immediate regulatory compliance blocker2.  
* **Required Fix**: Update sweeps\_en.json to replace forbidden terms with compliant sweepstakes terminology2. Replace "Buy" with "Get" or "Instantly Trigger", and replace "Bet" with "Play" or "Total Play"2.

### **Finding 2 \[BLOCKER\]: External Asset Network Fetch Violates Static CDN Isolation Rules**

* **Location**: frontend/src/index.html (Line 8\)  
* **Evidence**: The HTML template includes an external resource request: \<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700\&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"\>.  
* **Impact**: Platform security policies mandate that game builds must be entirely self-contained static packages hosted exclusively on the Stake Engine Content Delivery Network5. Fetching assets from external domain endpoints introduces runtime vulnerabilities, violates static build constraints, and breaks game execution during offline or isolated replay rendering4.  
* **Required Fix**: Remove the external Google Fonts URI link. Download the required font files directly into frontend/src/assets/fonts/ and declare them locally within the stylesheet using CSS @font-face rules.

### **Finding 3 \[MAJOR\]: Mini-Player (Popout View) Layout Truncation and Interface Collision**

* **Location**: frontend/src/components/Board.svelte and reports/screens/mini\_player\_preview.png  
* **Evidence**: Visual inspection of committed screenshot proof reports/screens/mini\_player\_preview.png indicates that when the game is rendered inside a 320x320 pixel popout window, the reel framework collides with the bottom status bar, rendering the credit balance and win count partially obscured.  
* **Impact**: Stake Engine requires full support for mini-player popout views without visual overlap, clipped text, or board distortion5. Substandard scaling under mini-player dimensions negatively impacts player usability during background play5.  
* **Required Fix**: Implement CSS container queries on the primary canvas container to scale down reel padding and automatically hide decorative side panels when the rendering height falls below 400 pixels.

### **Finding 4 \[MINOR\]: Super Mode Maximum Win Hit Frequency Discrepancy**

* **Location**: SUBMISSION\_DOSSIER.md vs games/future\_spinner/library/publish\_files/lookUpTable\_super\_0.csv  
* **Evidence**: The submission dossier claims that Super Mode exhibits a ![][image5] cap probability of ![][image8] (![][image9]). However, independent recomputation directly from the shipped lookup table yields exactly 106 cap outcomes out of ![][image3] total weighted combinations, establishing an actual probability of ![][image10] (![][image11]).  
* **Impact**: Discrepancies between official submission documentation and executable math files create auditing conflicts during game verification and backend registration3.  
* **Required Fix**: Re-sync the submission dossier statistical breakdown to reflect exact probabilities calculated directly from the production lookup tables3.

### **Finding 5 \[POLISH\]: Audio Count-Up Duration Misalignment on Big Win Celebrations**

* **Location**: frontend/src/components/WinDisplay.svelte and frontend/src/audio/soundManager.ts  
* **Evidence**: On wins ranging between ![][image12] and ![][image13] bet, the numerical rollup animation is set to run for a duration of 4,000 milliseconds, whereas the associated audio track sfx\_win\_countup.mp3 terminates after 3,550 milliseconds.  
* **Impact**: The resulting 450-millisecond window of silence before the final payout fanfare disrupts the visual and acoustic synchronization of high-tier win presentations.  
* **Required Fix**: Adjust the ticker interpolation duration in WinDisplay.svelte to match the 3,500 millisecond audio track length or extend the audio loop asset.

### **Detailed Mathematical Synthesis**

> 1. **Return-to-Player Bandwidth**: The current Stake Engine platform parameters enforce an overall RTP ceiling of 96.70% and require all selectable modes to fit within a ![][image57] relative bandwidth band1. The recomputed overall weighted RTP across all modes is ![][image27], adhering to platform limits1. The maximum delta between any two modes occurs between Bonus Buy (![][image31]) and Cruise Mode (![][image29]), establishing a spread of ![][image58], which easily satisfies the ![][image57] bandwidth constraint1.  
> 2. **Cap Hard-Stop Verification**: Evaluating every row in the static lookup tables confirms that no outcome produces a total payout multiplier exceeding ![][image4] hundredths (![][image5] base bet)3. The mathematical generation layer truncates tail events strictly at ![][image5], eliminating un-capped liability risks3.  
> 3. **Max Win Obtainability and Tail Risk**: Platform rules mandate that the advertised maximum win must be achievable through normal gameplay4. The calculated hit frequency for the maximum payout cap ranges from ![][image6] spins in Bonus Buy mode to ![][image7] spins in Base Mode4. This demonstrates that the ![][image5] cap is obtainable without over-concentrating total return inside extreme tail events4.  
> 4. **Tail Contribution Analysis**: In Base Mode, wins residing in the top ![][image59] of the probability density function account for ![][image52] of total RTP, indicating balanced base game churn. In contrast, Super Buy mode exhibits heavy tail concentration, with the top ![][image59] of outcomes generating ![][image56] of total mode return. While appropriate for a high-cost ![][image60] feature mode, this volatility structure necessitates robust bankroll warnings in player rules5.

## **Quality Assessment**

The visual presentation, animation smoothness, mobile adaptability, and interface communication have been evaluated using committed screen proofs, asset renders, and automated QA logs in reports/5.

| Quality Dimension | Score | Primary Evaluation Findings |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Art Consistency** | 8.5 / 10 | Cohesive neon cyberpunk palette, crisp high-resolution symbol iconography, and strong visual distinction between low and high pay tiers5. |
| **Animation Quality** | 7.2 / 10 | Smooth reel spin deceleration and scatter anticipation effects; minor FPS dips (down to 41 FPS) logged during ![][image61]\-way win bursts on low-end mobile devices5. |
| **Mobile Experience** | 6.0 / 10 | Excellent touch target sizing (![][image62]) and responsive scaling in portrait mode; penalized due to UI overlapping in mini-player popout view5. |
| **Player Communication** | 8.0 / 10 | Transparent rules disclosure, dynamic paytable updating, and clear feature cost notifications; penalized for social language key mismatches2. |

### **Art Consistency and Theme Execution**

The aesthetic structure of *Future Spinner* establishes a well-defined cyberpunk automotive theme1. Analysis of reports/screens/landscape\_main.png reveals clean vector rendering, high contrast, and consistent lighting across all symbol tiers. High-paying symbols (custom tuned supercars) are easily distinguished from low-paying card suits by distinct neon glows (Cyan, Magenta, Gold). Background scenes transition smoothly between base play and feature modes without introducing visual clutter behind the ![][image63] reel matrix. Brand assets, paytable diagrams, and modal windows maintain thematic alignment throughout the interface5.

### **Animation Quality and Framerate Performance**

Reel mechanics employ pleasing easing curves during spin cycles, and scatter land events trigger distinct frame illuminations that build appropriate tension. Win line evaluations for simple combinations render cleanly. However, automated frame analysis data in reports/qa/frame\_gates.json highlights minor performance bottlenecks during complex ![][image61]\-way combination wins accompanied by full-screen particle overlays5. On simulated mid-tier mobile hardware (Mali-G57 GPU profiles), frame rates drop from a baseline 60 FPS down to 41 FPS during multi-line explosions. Furthermore, visual count-up animations on big win presentations suffer from minor acoustic desynchronization, as noted in Finding 5\.

### **Mobile Experience and Responsiveness**

The user interface exhibits strong responsiveness across standard smartphone and tablet viewports5. Audit logs in reports/qa/touch\_targets\_audit.json verify that all primary touch targets (Spin, Bet Adjust, Autoplay, Mode Select) exceed the minimum touch dimension requirement of 44x44 pixels, preventing accidental inputs5. Text elements retain legibility when scaled down to 320-pixel mobile screens. However, mobile performance receives a substantial score reduction due to mini-player popout defects5. As documented in Finding 3, screenshot proof reports/screens/mini\_player\_preview.png demonstrates that scaling the game canvas into a small ![][image64] aspect ratio causes the bottom control overlay to collide with lower reel symbols, obscuring the primary balance display5.

### **Clarity of Player Communication**

Interface disclosures and rule explanations are clearly articulated5. The rules modal (frontend/src/components/RulesModal.svelte) presents a thorough breakdown of ![][image61]\-ways evaluation rules, feature trigger requirements, mode cost multipliers, dynamic symbol payouts, and the overall ![][image5] win cap5. The paytable component automatically recalculates numerical coin payouts relative to the user's active bet selection5. However, communication clarity is compromised in social casino mode (social=true), where unmapped localization strings allow prohibited gambling terminology ("Bet", "Buy Bonus") to appear on overlay modals, violating stake.us communication rules2.

## **UNVERIFIABLE WITHOUT PLAY**

Because this review was conducted using read-only access to source code, static lookup tables, and committed proof artifacts, specific dynamic aspects of the real-time player experience cannot be verified without live build execution:

* **Input Latency and Kinetic Feeling**: The real-time physical feel, button feedback latency, and spin deceleration physics during active user input via touch screen or spacebar.  
* **Contextual Audio Ducking and Mix Balance**: Dynamic sound channel ducking, frequency balancing, and audio bus behavior when multiple sound effects trigger simultaneously during fastplay or continuous free spins.  
* **Long-Term Hardware Thermal and Memory Stability**: Client-side GPU thermal behavior, battery consumption rates, and JavaScript garbage collection stability during extended autoplay sessions exceeding 1,000 continuous spins.  
* **Tactile Gesture Quality on Curved Mobile Displays**: Real-device touch cancellation, edge-swipe handling, and multi-touch boundary safety on physical mobile screens with rounded corners or display cutouts.  
* **Network Recovery and Disconnect Reconciliation**: Client state recovery, visual animation resumption, and balance synchronization following abrupt WebSocket drops or mobile network handoffs during active spin resolution.

## **Score**

### **Fractional Score: 1.67 / 3.00**

*Future Spinner* receives a fractional score of **1.67** on the 0-to-3 platform rubric1. The title demonstrates mathematical rigor, verified game statelessness, clean graphic styling, and thorough rule disclosures1. The math model adheres strictly to platform RTP limits, mode bandwidth constraints, and maximum payout hard stops1. However, as a first-time submission evaluated under strict gatekeeping standards, leniency cannot be granted for clear compliance failures1. The presence of non-compliant gambling terminology in social casino localization files represents a regulatory blocker for stake.us publication2. Additionally, the inclusion of an external Google Fonts URL violates static asset containment requirements, and mini-player popout UI clipping harms mobile execution quality5. Remediating these specific defects is straightforward, but until resolved, the game cannot be approved for live publication1.  
"Future Spinner exhibits strong mathematical balancing and compelling visuals, but is gated at 1.67 pending remediation of sweepstakes language non-compliance, external font dependencies, and mini-player UI truncation."2

## **Path to Three Stars**

To resolve all identified findings and raise the approval score to a top-tier **3.00**, We Roll Spinners must execute the following targeted fixes2:

> 1. **Fix Sweepstakes Terminology (Blocker)**: Update frontend/src/locales/sweeps\_en.json (Lines 14, 28\) to replace forbidden terms ("Bet" ![][image65] "Play", "Buy Bonus" ![][image65] "Get Feature"), ensuring strict adherence to stake.us sweepstakes requirements2.  
> 2. **Remove External Network Dependencies (Blocker)**: Remove the external Google Fonts URI request from frontend/src/index.html (Line 8). Bundle the required Orbitron font assets locally within frontend/src/assets/fonts/ to achieve complete static CDN self-containment5.  
> 3. **Resolve Mini-Player Layout Collision (Major)**: Refactor CSS layout rules in frontend/src/components/Board.svelte using container queries to automatically scale control padding and hide non-essential side graphics when rendering in 320px mini-player viewports5.  
> 4. **Re-sync Submission Documentation (Minor)**: Update SUBMISSION\_DOSSIER.md to state the exact calculated Super Mode max win probability of ![][image10], eliminating audit discrepancies against shipped lookup tables3.  
> 5. **Synchronize Big Win Audio Cues (Polish)**: Adjust the counter roll-up duration in frontend/src/components/WinDisplay.svelte to 3,500 milliseconds to perfectly align with the audio track length during high-tier win presentations.
